name: Max & Ruby
description: Meet two funny bunny siblings, the energetic and mischievous Max, and the patient, smart and goal-oriented Ruby. The show models empowering messages by showing Max and Ruby playing together and resolving their differences respectfully and supportively.

videos.title: Max and Ruby Afternoons
videos.overview: Based on a series of children's books by Rosemary Wells, this charming animated children's program chronicles the sibling rivalry between brother and sister bunnies Max and Ruby. Never content to let older sister Ruby boss him around, three-year-old Max always manages to brew up some mischief to get his own way. Max and Ruby - Afternoons with Max and Ruby video This collection includes six fun-filled episodes: "Max's Froggy Friend," "Max's Music," "Max Gets Wet," "Max's Dragon Shirt," "Max's Rabbit Racer," and "Roger's Choice.

videos.title: Max and Ruby Perfect Pumpkin
videos.overview: Based on a series of children's books by Rosemary Wells, this charming animated children's program chronicles the sibling rivalry between brother and sister bunnies Max and Ruby. Never content to let older sister Ruby boss him around, three-year-old Max always manages to brew up some mischief to get his own way.

videos.title: Everybunny Loves Winter
videos.overview: Join Max & Ruby this winter as they play and have a fun in the snow, make gingerbread houses, and even play duck duck goose! The DVD includes 4 episodes of approximately 24 minutes in length.

videos.title: Max and Ruby Bunny Tales
videos.overview: Max & Ruby: Bunny Tales movie was released Jan 11, 2011 by the Nickelodeon studio. This animated release for kids includes 12 episodes of the series MAX & RUBY, following the furry star on a number of fun adventures, engaging in fun antics like getting Max to try on a suit, building a fairytale castle, and learning important lessons about caring and responsibility.

videos.title: Ruby's Piano Practice
videos.overview: Ruby has a piano practice, and Max can't find his fire truck. Ruby then tries to make Max play with different toys but at the end Ruby realizes that Max's fire truck must have been in the piano the whole time.

videos.title: Max's Bath
videos.overview: Max is still hungry after his lunch is all over him instead of in him, and Ruby decides to give him a bath, but unfortunately, he uses sherbet tubs and a grape juice glass as a boat, and that manages to get him dirtier than before, so Ruby gives him a shower. After his shower, he points out that Ruby's clothes have been stained, meaning she needs to wash now.

videos.title: Max's Bedtime
videos.overview: Max can't sleep until he finds his red rubber elephant. Later, he spies it must have been under his bed the whole time.NOTE: At the end, Max says "Good Night, Ruby." This is one of two instances that Max speaks a full sentence.

videos.title: Hide and Seek
videos.overview: Ruby tries to teach Max to play Hide-and-Seek, but when they play, Max is too little to understand the rules and he does not want to give Ruby a turn to hide. When Ruby unsuccessfully tries to explain to him that it is her turn to hide since Max already had a turn, Max takes his chances to hide when Ruby isn't looking.

videos.title: Max's Breakfast
videos.overview: Max isn't eager he'll like his breakfast, a bunny-side-up egg, and wants strawberries instead. Ruby is distracted when Max tries attempts to hide his egg.

videos.title: Louise's Secret
videos.overview: Ruby can't wait for the phone to ring, because Louise has a big secret to tell her. But when the phone finally rings, Max chooses that exact time to play with his loud toys.

videos.title: Max Misses the Bus
videos.overview: Ruby is all ready to catch the next bus to Louise's house, but Max wants to stay home and play with his toys. Ruby tries to convince Max to come by promising to bring his toys along, but they miss bus after bus because of Max's antics. Will the bunnies arrive at Louise's safely?

videos.title: Max's Wormcake
videos.overview: Ruby wants to plant marigolds in a garden but its the same place Max has chosen to make a "worm cake", a mud-pie consisting of soaked soil, stones, and worms. He uses all her marigold-planting materials in his worm cake, but then he gives the worm cake back to Ruby, where it's used for a good cause.

videos.title: Max's Rainy Day
videos.overview: Ruby and Max want to go outside to play in the rain, but Max wants to go out in his sunny day clothes. Ruby tries to get Max to put on a raincoat, but by the time both of the bunnies are ready to go out, the rain clouds have cleared and the sun is out. Can Max and Ruby still have fun in the rain? No. But they can have fun with the hose!

videos.title: Camp Out
videos.overview: Max and Ruby are having a camp out but Max wants to sleep outside instead of the tent. When Max stuffs all his toys in the tent, He and Ruby are forced to sleep outside, much to his delight.

videos.title: Ruby's Clubhouse
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise build a clubhouse, but Max thinks he can sneak in just because Ruby and Louise are not in the clubhouse. Later, Ruby builds Max his own clubhouse.NOTE: This is one of few instances that Ruby's passion is used against her rather than dovetailing with Max's.

videos.title: Max's Picnic
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are bird watching but Max wants his cupcake. Later, he finds a speckled warbler, feeds it his cupcake and shows the warbler to Ruby and Louise.

videos.title: Max's Halloween
videos.overview: Max wants to be something scary for Halloween like a Vampire. But Ruby would rather have him a prince to go with her princess costume believing that Max will scare Grandma when they trick or treat at her house.

videos.title: Ruby's Leaf Collection
videos.overview: Ruby decides to start a collection of leaves, and really wants to find a rare leaf known as the big tooth aspen leaf. But Max keeps getting in the way of finding the leaf. Will Ruby be able to complete her collection?

videos.title: The Blue Tarantula
videos.overview: Max insists on Ruby reading him a scary mystery story before bed. After some hesitation, Ruby agrees to, and reads Max a story about the blue tarantula, who crawls on little bunnies at night when they are asleep and bites them, causing them to die. Max stays up all night in fear of the tarantula. Will Ruby find a way to get him to go to sleep?

videos.title: Ruby's Merit Badge
videos.overview: Ruby wants to earn her First Aid merit badge. When Ruby tries to get her merit badge by bandaging dolls, she suggests she bandage a real person. But that real person is Max...and Max's antics cause Ruby to earn a different badge.

videos.title: Max's Apple
videos.overview: Ruby is all ready to catch the next bus to Louise's house, but Max wants to stay home and play with his toys. Ruby tries to convince Max to come by promising to bring his toys along, but they miss bus after bus because of Max's antics. Will the bunnies arrive at Louise's safely?

videos.title: Quiet, Max!
videos.overview: Max and Ruby go to the Huffingtons' house to play while Baby Huffington is napping. Max wants to listen to the radio, starting a ruckus, and causes Baby Huffington to wake up and cry. How will the bunnies stop the baby from crying?

videos.title: Max Cleans Up
videos.overview: Ruby wants Max to clean his room, and Max stuffs the mess into his pocket instead of placing his toys and things where they belong. What's going to happen when Ruby finds out?

videos.title: Max's Cuckoo Clock
videos.overview: While Mrs. Huffington is out at her garden tea party in the backyard, Ruby's job is to put Baby Huffington to sleep. But Max wants to play with the Huffingtons' cuckoo clock, and the sound of the clock might wake the baby...

videos.title: Ruby's Jewelry Box
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are making a Queen of Egypt tiara, and Ruby is not in her room. Max tries to look in Ruby's jewelry box, but is caught by Ruby, who doesn't want Max in her room. Will Max ever see what's inside the box?

videos.title: Bunny Cakes
videos.overview: Ruby wants to make Grandma an 'Angel Surprise Cake with Raspberry Fluff Icing' for Grandma's birthday, but Max wants to make Grandma an earthworm cake. Ruby thinks that Grandma will like her cake best, but Grandma really appreciates both cakes!

videos.title: Bunny Party
videos.overview: At Grandma's birthday party, Ruby has invited her dolls. To get his own toys into the party, Max disguises them as Ruby's dolls.  NOTE: Max does not speak in this episode.

videos.title: Bunny Money
videos.overview: Ruby has saved a wallet full of money to buy Grandma a music box with skating ballerinas on top for her birthday, but shopping with Max costs more than Ruby planned.

videos.title: Max's Birthday
videos.overview: Max gets so many presents for his birthday that he forgets to open one. So Ruby opens it for him and finds a "wind-up lobster." Max is in for the chase of his life, only he's the one being chased -- by the lobster!

videos.title: Max's New Suit
videos.overview: Max refuses to get dressed in his new suit for a party he's invited too.

videos.title: Goodnight Max
videos.overview: Max cannot go to sleep, and keeps waking up in the middle of the night. His antics cause his clothes to get stained and dirty, and Ruby can't get Max to sleep. Eventually, Ruby's Walkie-Talkie Bear toy gets Max some shut-eye.

videos.title: Max's Christmas
videos.overview: Max is full of questions when Ruby hurries to bed on Christmas Eve so that Santa Claus can come. No one ever stays up to see Santa. No one except Max.

videos.title: Ruby's Snow Queen
videos.overview: Max wants to play with a screaming, green alien-gorilla, but Ruby insists that he helps her create a snow queen to welcome Grandma. After the snow queen is finished, Max's gorilla toy has vanished. Will the bunnies find out that the alien gorilla was run over when Ruby and Max were building the snow queen and is currently inside the snow formation?

videos.title: Max's Rocket Run
videos.overview: Max wants to sled down a large hill called Rocket Run with his toboggan, but Ruby and Louise only allow Max to go on Bunny Hill, a small hill used as a sledding location for younger bunnies. What will happen?

videos.title: Max's Chocolate Chicken
videos.overview: Max wants to eat a chocolate chicken an Easter bunny left on a birdbath.

videos.title: Ruby's Beauty Shop
videos.overview: Louise and Ruby decide to pretend they own a salon, but Max is the customer!

videos.title: Max Drives Away
videos.overview: It's breakfast time, and Max wants ice cream. Ruby says that nobody eats ice cream for breakfast. So Max drives off in his pedal car and goes to the only person who understands.

videos.title: Ruby's Lemonade Stand
videos.overview: Ruby's Lemonade Stand. Ruby and Louise are having a lemonade stand for Bunny Scouts.

videos.title: Ruby's Rummage Sale
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are having a rummage sale to raise money for a Bunny Scout field trip, but Max wants to keep the toys Ruby and Louise want to sell.

videos.title: Ruby's Magic Act
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are practicing their magic act for the Bunny Scouts talent show, and they need Max to be their volunteer from the audience. Max wants to know how they do their tricks, but Ruby and Louise insist on 'magician code of honor'. In the end, Max is the one who surprises them with his own magic trick!

videos.title: Max's Valentine
videos.overview: Valentine's Day is a busy time for Ruby and Louise, who make special Valentine cards for their friends. Max wants to make a Valentine, but he's too little to use scissors and glue. Ruby gives Max the important job of taking her Valentines to the mailbox, and Max ends up making a special Valentine delivery of his own.

videos.title: Ruby Flies a Kite
videos.overview: Ruby tries to fly a kite.

videos.title: Super Max
videos.overview: Ruby is preparing to go for a picnic with Louise and her dolly Sally-Swims-a-Lot, but Max is listening to his favorite radio show, Super Bunny. When Sally suddenly goes missing, it's up to Super Max to come to the rescue.

videos.title: Max's Work of Art
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are painting pictures for the Bunny Scout art exhibit -- and they use Max as a model. But Max doesn't want to model -- he wants to paint!

videos.title: Max Meets Morris
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise think that Max and Morris (Louise's toddler cousin) will become friends while they make a banner for the Bunny Scout Picnic.

videos.title: Ruby's Scavenger Hunt
videos.overview: The Bunny Scout leader has organized a scavenger hunt in the park for all the Bunny Scouts, but Max keeps interrupting Ruby's search.

videos.title: Ruby's Hiccups
videos.overview: Ruby has the hiccups and Max can't find his monster mask.

videos.title: The Big Picture
videos.overview: Max and Ruby have a picture to take and send to their Grandma but all Max wants to do is chase a butterfly.

videos.title: Ruby's Stage Show
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise decide to put on a show for Grandma, but Max wants to wear his dragon mask instead.

videos.title: Max's Froggy Friend
videos.overview: Making friends with a frog in the creek, Max wants to take it home with him. But Ruby is planning a tea party for Grandma, and that's no place for a froggy.

videos.title: Max's Music
videos.overview: Ruby, Valerie and Louise try to be a trio called Ruby's Red Hot Trio playing "The Farmer in the Dell", but they keep getting interrupted by Max's own music playing.

videos.title: Max Gets Wet
videos.overview: Max and Ruby fix their garden up when it shrivels up but Max wants to go swimming in his pool and he has to wait one half hour.

videos.title: Ruby's Tea Party
videos.overview: Ruby wants to have a tea party with her dollies, but Max wants to play pirates.

videos.title: Max Is It
videos.overview: Max wants to eat his Dribbler, but is it in a game of Freeze Tag with Ruby, Louise, and Valerie, and they're impossible for Max to get.

videos.title: Ruby's Science Project
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are doing a science project and Max wants candy.

videos.title: Ruby's Panda Prize
videos.overview: At the carnival, Ruby wants to win a panda bear prize and Max wants jelly balls.

videos.title: Ruby's Roller Skates
videos.overview: Ruby wants to learn how to roller-skate and is interrupted by Max wanting his Tow-a-Ton Tow Truck.

videos.title: Ghost Bunny
videos.overview: The Bunny Scout leaders are having a jamboree, and the highlight (after s'mores) is telling ghost stories around the campfire.

videos.title: Max's Bug Salad
videos.overview: Max wants to add bugs to Grandma's gelatin salad.

videos.title: Ruby's Beach Party
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise want to have a beach party in Max and Ruby's yard, but Max and Morris want to play dump-truck.

videos.title: Super Max to the Rescue
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise want to play circus in the yard. When Super Max sees his red rubber elephant in peril at the circus, he's to the rescue!

videos.title: Max's Dragon Shirt
videos.overview: At the department store, Max wants a dragon shirt, but Ruby only has $5 to buy him a brand-new pair of overalls.

videos.title: Max's Rabbit Racer
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are taking baton twirling lessons from Mrs. Huffington, and Max is entertaining himself and Baby Huffington with his Rabbit Racer.

videos.title: Roger's Choice
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise want to play with Ruby's best male friend Roger Piazza but Max wants Roger to play cars with him.

videos.title: Ruby's Pajama Party
videos.overview: Ruby, Louise and Valerie are having a pajama party, but Max wants to come too.

videos.title: Baby Max
videos.overview: Louise and Ruby try to get Max to pretend to be a baby, but Max doesn't like that game. He just wants to go on the playground slide.

videos.title: Bunny Scout Brownies
videos.overview: Max keeps sampling the Bunny Scout brownies Ruby has to sell.

videos.title: Max's Shadow
videos.overview: Ruby and Valerie are trying to make a ballerina poster. Max is playing with his shadow, which keeps disappearing in the sun.

videos.title: Max Remembers
videos.overview: Discovering a string tied around Max's finger, Ruby leaps to the assumption that he's supposed to remember something.

videos.title: Ruby's Candy Store
videos.overview: Ruby wants to be the owner of the candy store, but unfortunately, she gets to know the candy's tastes a little too well.

videos.title: Max's Check Up
videos.overview: Louise and Ruby play doctor. Max is chosen as the patient, but he wants to play with his markers.

videos.title: Max's Prize
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise look for special things for Ruby's charm bracelet.

videos.title: Space Max
videos.overview: Ruby, Valerie and Louise are going to make a float for the Bunny Scout Parade, but Max wants to play spaceman.

videos.title: Ruby's Figure Eight
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise go ice-skating to try to make figure-eights.

videos.title: Ruby's Surprise Party
videos.overview: Ruby plans a surprise party for Louise, and she employs Max as the lookout.

videos.title: Ruby's Tent
videos.overview: Ruby and Valerie try to put a tent together despite interruptions from... Super Max!

videos.title: Ruby Writes a Story
videos.overview: Ruby needs absolute quiet while she tries to write a story. But Max wants to play cowboy.

videos.title: Max's Dominoes
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise want to earn their hospitality badge by hosting a Bunny Scout meeting.

videos.title: Grandma's Attic
videos.overview: In Grandma's attic, Ruby is delighted to try on old clothes and Max finds an old chest that nobody ever goes into (according to Grandma).

videos.title: Max's Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Ruby and Max are at Grandma's to help with Thanksgiving dinner. Ruby is thrilled to help decorate, but Max just wants to sample Grandma's famous stuffing.

videos.title: Max's Pretend Friend
videos.overview: Ruby thinks that Max has a pretend friend.

videos.title: Fireman Max
videos.overview: Ruby wants to practice jumping rope for the Bunny Scout jump-a-thon, but Max wants to play fireman, and he keeps tripping her up.

videos.title: Ruby's Easter Bonnet
videos.overview: Ruby is making an Easter Bonnet for the Bunny Scout Easter Bonnet contest, while Max tries to teach Froggy to hop.

videos.title: Max's Easter Parade
videos.overview: Ruby is decorating Easter Eggs but Max wants to see an Easter parade.

videos.title: Max & the Easter Bunny
videos.overview: Ruby and the rest of the Bunny Scouts are eager to participate in the annual Easter Egg Hunt.

videos.title: Ruby's Hippity Hop Dance
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise tries to learn the Hippity Hop Dance. Meanwhile, Roger teaches Max how to play football.

videos.title: Ruby's Bird Bath
videos.overview: Ruby tries to make an environmentally-correct bird bath for a Bunny Scout merit badge, but Max keeps putting bath toys in it.

videos.title: Super Max Saves the World
videos.overview: Max (as Super Bunny) and Morris (as Zoom-Zoom) pretend to be superheroes while Ruby and Louise make a science project.

videos.title: Ruby Delivers
videos.overview: Ruby must deliver some fliers for Bunny Scout cupcakes.

videos.title: Getting Crabby at the Beach
videos.overview: Ruby tries to collect seashells.

videos.title: Max Babysits
videos.overview: Max and Ruby are going to the Huffingtons' house to look after Baby Huffington, who seems to like noisy toys instead of gentle sounds.

videos.title: Max's Fire Flies
videos.overview: Max wants to catch fire flies.

videos.title: Max & Ruby's Fashion Show
videos.overview: Ruby, Louise and Max decide to have their own fashion show, but Max just wants to dress up as a pirate.

videos.title: Ruby’s Sing-a-long
videos.overview: Max and Ruby want to be in a talent show. Ruby wants to sing and play the piano at the same time, and Max wants to sing too.

videos.title: Ruby's Safari
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise go on a safari, but Max thinks his toys would be perfect. Well, his red rubber elephant seems perfect for the safari.

videos.title: Max's Mudbath
videos.overview: Max wants to play in the mud.

videos.title: Max's Lost Lizard
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise worry when their chameleon  disappears out of the cage, while Max enjoys its abilities.

videos.title: Surprise Ruby
videos.overview: It's Ruby's birthday and Ruby expects her friends to throw her a surprise party at their home. But Ruby must give chase when Max makes off with her birthday tiara.

videos.title: Ruby's Birthday Party
videos.overview: Ruby's friends throw her a birthday party at Grandma's house. But before they can have cake, Ruby insists they must play some birthday games first.

videos.title: Ruby's Birthday Present
videos.overview: Ruby unwraps her birthday presents and plans to save all the pretty wrapping paper. Meanwhile, Max tries to wrap a gift for his sister.

videos.title: Ruby's Puppet Show
videos.overview: Max attempts to get a role in Ruby and Louise's puppet show.

videos.title: Sugar Plum Max
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise practice The Sugar Plum Fairy, while Max tries various attempts to get a sugar plum.

videos.title: Max's Ant Farm
videos.overview: Max and Ruby are on a chase to get Max's ants back in the ant farm, before Ruby's guests notice.

videos.title: Ruby's Loose Tooth
videos.overview: Ruby and Max try to search for Ruby's loose tooth that was lost.

videos.title: Ruby Scores
videos.overview: Ruby tries to play soccer, but keeps getting surrounded by Max's robots.

videos.title: Ruby's Sandcastle
videos.overview: Ruby wants to make a sandcastle, but Max wants to get in the water.

videos.title: Grandma's Berry Patch
videos.overview: Max and Ruby pick raspberries, blueberries, and blackberries so Grandma can make her special surprise berry recipe..."mushed berry smoothies".

videos.title: Ruby's Bunny Scout Banner
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise paint a banner for their Bunny Scout parade, but Max constantly interrupts them.

videos.title: Ruby's Detective Agency
videos.overview: Grandma has a surprise for Ruby, but before Ruby can go to Grandma's house she must solve the mystery of Mrs. Quack's disappearance.

videos.title: Max's Rocket Racer
videos.overview: Max and Ruby are at the East Bunny Hop Summer Fair. When Ruby and Louise point out that Max is below the line (height) for the Rocket Racer ride, Max sets out to find ways to be taller.

videos.title: Max and Morris Blast Off!
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise host a special bunny scout meeting to celebrate Bunny Scout Leader's birthday. The meeting gets that extra special touch when Super Bunny and Zoom Zoom "help".

videos.title: Max's Candy Apple
videos.overview: Max and Ruby are at the East Bunny Hop Fall Fair where there's races, food, and prizes. Max has his sights set on a candy apple, but Ruby insists she and Max participate in some races first to win a prize.

videos.title: Ruby Riding Hood
videos.overview: Ruby wants to bring cookies to Grandma's House, but Max wants to eat them, so Ruby tells him the story of Little Ruby Riding Hood and the Big Max Wolf.

videos.title: Max & the Beanstalk
videos.overview: Max is not to keen on his dinner: green beans. Ruby tells him a tale about how beans are good for him.

videos.title: The Froggy Prince
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are putting on a fairy tale show while Max is playing with Froggy.

videos.title: Max & Ruby's Perfect Pumpkin
videos.overview: Max and Ruby are in Mr. Piazza's store in search of the perfect Halloween pumpkin.

videos.title: Max's Jack-o-Lantern
videos.overview: Max (vampire) and Ruby (fairy godmother) dress up for a Halloween party at their home. Before their guests arrive, Ruby tells Max to design a pumpkin face for Grandma to carve, but Ruby insists it must be a happy, smiley pumpkin.

videos.title: Max's Big Boo!
videos.overview: Max (vampire) and Ruby (fairy godmother) prepare to go trick-or-treating. Max takes every opportunity to scare Ruby, but Ruby knows all his tricks.

videos.title: Grandma's Present
videos.overview: Max and Ruby buy Grandma a Christmas present.

videos.title: Max & Ruby's Christmas Tree
videos.overview: Ruby and Max decorate their Christmas tree, but Max thinks toys would be beautiful on it.

videos.title: Max's Snow Plow
videos.overview: Ruby tries to shovel the snow off the lawn to make room for Grandma to get to their house.

videos.title: Max's Snow Day
videos.overview: Max wants to go outside in the snow, but there's a blizzard!

videos.title: Max's Snow Bunny
videos.overview: Max tries to find out if the snow bunny is real.

videos.title: Max's Mix Up
videos.overview: Max switches his snow clothes with Morris.

videos.title: Grandma's Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are going on a treasure hunt set up by Grandma. Max wants to make it a pirate treasure hunt.

videos.title: Ruby's Jigsaw Puzzle
videos.overview: Ruby is assembling a jigsaw puzzle, but Max's wind-up lobster swipes one of the pieces. Max chases it all over the house and hunts it down to retrieve it.

videos.title: Ruby's Recital
videos.overview: Grandma calls up Ruby and suggests a music recital in the garden. Ruby cannot find an instrument she wants to play, but then finds out the recital is for her.

videos.title: Ruby's Home Run
videos.overview: Ruby and her friends are playing baseball. This is Ruby's first time playing and it seems Max and his toy airplanes are not making the game any easier.

videos.title: Ruby's Missing Tune
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are practicing their ballet that they're going to put on for Grandma. Max would rather play in his race car. When he breaks Ruby's boombox by accident, he helps them with the music, causing Ruby to remember the tune of Strauss' Blue Danube Waltz.

videos.title: Ruby's Handstand
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are working to earn their Gymnastics badge and in order to earn it, they have to do a handstand for 5 whole seconds. Max wants to play on the swings.

videos.title: Ruby's Rainbow
videos.overview: Ruby is trying to make a rainbow painting for Grandma, but Max keeps trying to get outside.

videos.title: Home Tweet Home
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are making a birdhouse for the birds, but Max keeps asking for snacks. Max took Ruby's spool of thread by accident but adds a ribbon instead.

videos.title: Max's Mudpie
videos.overview: Max wants to make a mud pie. Ruby wants him to stay clean, because Grandma's coming over with a treat.

videos.title: Max Saves The Parade
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise are making a float for the Fall Fun Festival Parade. Max and Roger are making one as well, but when both pairs clash, Max and Roger decide to combine the floats into one.

videos.title: Max’s Big Kick
videos.overview: Roger is teaching Max how to kick a football while Ruby and Louise make a leaf collage, but somehow the park does not seem big enough for the four of them.

videos.title: Ruby’s Horn of Plenty
videos.overview: It is the fall and Ruby is picking vegetables to decorate her cornucopia, but Max would rather eat them instead.

videos.title: Ruby’s Hoola Hoop
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise build a castle out of blocks.

videos.title: Max and The Martians
videos.overview: Ruby and Louise play hopscotch.

videos.title: Ruby’s Real Cinderella
videos.overview: Max befriends a grasshopper.

videos.title: Max and Ruby and the New Baby
